claims.claim: Exact source-upgrade staging uses the isolated-attested installed source SHA to validate the migration-history terminal generation, allowing the reviewed control Operator to reside in a different source tree. Replay also checks the completed history chain against that witness.
Ordinary callers retain the default installed-generation path check. The exact v2 handoff identity and target-owned admission path remain unchanged, and staging creates no RUN or FAILURE.

The focused regression stages and replays the exact upgrade with a separate installed distribution and completed historical edge, without monkeypatching _installed_generation_sha or bypassing the isolated witness. It also checks the ordinary path-mismatch rejection and isolated-witness negative cases.

Both authorized architecture documents distinguish control source, installed migration-source witness, and target generation, and describe the downstream TASK-259 and TASK-207 sequence as prospective. The clean commit changes only the four authorized files.
